Rental Terms

The fine print, kept simple.

Our standard terms for every reservation. Anything specific to your rental is confirmed with you at booking.

01

Who can rent

Renters must be 21 or older, with a valid driver’s license and full-coverage auto insurance that extends to the rental vehicle.

02

Authorized drivers

Only drivers named on the booking may drive the vehicle.

03

Cancellation

Cancel 48 hours or more before pickup for a full refund of anything prepaid. Inside 48 hours, the first day’s rental is retained; on a deposit booking, the deposit is retained. A no-show is charged the full rental. Returning early does not refund unused days.

04

Security deposit (Mercedes-AMG GLE 53 Coupe)

$800, charged at booking and refunded after the vehicle is returned and inspected, less any charges for damage, tickets, tolls, fuel or cleaning. If you cancel inside 48 hours of pickup, the deposit is retained.

05

Mileage

Mileage is set for each rental at consultation. Ask when you book, and it is confirmed for your reservation.

06

Fuel

Out full, back full. If it comes back under full, you pay the cost of the fuel at the prevailing local price per gallon, plus a $25 service fee on top.

07

Late return

One hour of grace, then an additional day at the daily rate.

08

Tickets, tolls and towing

These are the renter’s responsibility during the rental.

09

No smoking

Smoking in any vehicle carries a $250 cleaning fee.

10

If your vehicle is unavailable

We provide a comparable vehicle or a full refund.

11

Payment

Include the booking reference shown at checkout with any payment made through this site.

12

Where you can drive

The vehicle stays in North Carolina and its bordering states unless the owner approves a longer trip in writing before you leave.

13

Prohibited uses

No track use, racing, off-roading or towing. No rideshare or other commercial use, no sub-leasing, and no driving under the influence of drugs or alcohol.

14

Impound and admin fees

If the vehicle is impounded during your rental, you pay all impound, towing and storage costs. An administrative fee also applies to processing tickets, tolls and violations.

15

Wear beyond normal

Tire damage from burnouts or stunts, rim rash, and interior burns or stains are not normal wear. They are charged at repair cost.

Questions about any term? Call or text (929) 704-2002 or email book@firstclassrentalcars.net.
